summary.name: Sourcetree
summary.one_liner: Sourcetree is a free Git and Mercurial GUI client for Windows and Mac that lets you visualize and manage repositories without the command line.
use_cases: manage Git repositories without the command line
stage and discard changes by file, hunk or line
track large files with Git LFS
use Git and Mercurial on Windows or Mac
summary.what_it_does: Sourcetree is a graphical client for Git and Mercurial repositories on Windows and Mac. It shows branching diagrams and commit information, and lets users stage and discard changes by file, hunk or line. It supports interactive rebase, stash, cherry-pick, Git-flow, Git LFS and submodules. The page also mentions local commit search and a remote repository manager for searching and cloning repositories.
notable: Supports both Git and Mercurial in one GUI
Interactive rebase and Git-flow built in
caveats: Only Windows and Mac are named; no Linux support is mentioned
Page mainly markets features and does not state licensing terms beyond calling it free
